design_philosophy: Clean, professional corporate style utilizing sharp typography, bento-grid layouts, and generous negative space to convey authority and stability without feeling stale. Deep navy blue grounds the design, while stark white and cool grey provide structural clarity.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.

layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for section padding. Favor generous white space.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The Bento Grid Protocol for services and features. Use border-collapse style grids for technical/data-heavy sections.

surface_strategy.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#E2E8F0] shadow-sm
surface_strategy.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (#E2E8F0), no rounded corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Hover: slight shadow-lg and -translate-y-1.
surface_strategy.footer: Contrast Shift: Deep Navy (#0A192F) background with white/grey text. Massive vertical padding (py-24).

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A192F] text-white hover:bg-[#0F2646] rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#0A192F] text-[#0A192F] hover:bg-[#F8F9FA] rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300 font-medium

components.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Inputs must have rounded-none, border-[#E2E8F0], and focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A192F].
components.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism background, visible links on desktop (no hamburger on desktop), prominent 'Book a Consultation' CTA.

animations.scrolling: Lenis for smooth scrolling (Mandatory for premium feel).
animations.reveal: Framer Motion staggered fade-up for grid items and text blocks on scroll.
animations.hover: Subtle border color transitions and minimal Y-axis translation on cards.

hero.instructions: Use as full-screen or large section background with a bg-[#0A192F]/70 overlay to ensure text contrast.

founder_portrait.description: Professional portrait of founder Purnendu Shankar Upadhyay
founder_portrait.instructions: Use in the About Us section, accompanied by his bio. Display in a strict rectangular frame with a slight offset border for a stylized look.

about_team.description: Diverse group of professionals standing indoors
about_team.instructions: Use in the About or Culture section.

services_visuals.instructions: Use for Financial Advisory or Market Research service cards/modals.
Use for Business Consulting or Startup Consulting sections.

sections_instructions.Hero: Full viewport height. Background image with deep navy overlay (bg-[#0A192F]/70). Left-aligned typography. H1: 'Smart Solutions for Modern Businesses'. CTA: 'Book a Consultation' (Solid white button, navy text).
sections_instructions.AboutUs: Split layout. Left: Sticky section with 'About VM Consultancy' and intro text. Right: Scrollable content including Founder (Purnendu Shankar Upadhyay) bio, Mission, and Vision. Use large asymmetrical padding.
sections_instructions.Services: Implement a dense 'Technical Grid' (border-collapse, 1px borders between items). 5 Cards: Business Consulting, Financial Advisory, Startup Consulting, Market Research, Operational Strategy. Incorporate minimal lucide-react icons.
sections_instructions.Portfolio: Use an interactive horizontal scroll (framer-motion) or bento grid to display case studies and impact metrics. Focus on numbers (e.g., '30% Revenue Growth').
sections_instructions.Testimonials: Typographic focus. Massive serif quotation marks in the background (text-[#F1F5F9]). Clean author attribution below.
sections_instructions.Gallery: Masonry CSS grid of the provided gallery_images. Add subtle black/white to color transition on hover.
sections_instructions.Contact: Two-column bento. Left: Address, Phone, Email, Socials on a deep navy background card. Right: Clean Shadcn form on white background. Embed Google Map taking full width below.
sections_instructions.Footer: Massive padding (py-24), bg-[#0A192F]. Large typography for 'Let's Talk' CTA. Clean link lists.

testing_requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, navigation links) MUST include data-testid attributes.
